list.pageDescription: Multi-contractor site events with readiness from every required contractor before the work starts.
list.emptyOpenDescription: Schedule an event such as a slab pour or an installation, invite the contractors involved and track who is ready.
list.emptyClosedDescription: Completed, partially completed and cancelled events appear here with their outcome.
list.contractorCount: {count, plural, =0 {No contractors} one {# contractor} other {# contractors}}

fields.title: Title
fields.acknowledgementsHint: One per line, e.g. "Safety briefing read". Every required contractor must confirm each item.

create.title: New coordination event
create.description: Set the time and place, invite the contractors and choose who must confirm readiness.
create.noContractorsAvailable: No contractors with an agreement on this project yet.

detail.matrixDescription: The event is ready when every required contractor is ready and has confirmed the required acknowledgements.
detail.openIssues: {count, plural, one {# open issue} other {# open issues}}

invite.title: Invite participants
invite.contractorsHint: Required contractors decide the event readiness; optional ones are kept informed.
invite.teamHint: Site team members see the event in their schedule.

answer.title: Record a contractor answer
answer.description: Use this when the contractor answered by phone or on site. The answer is recorded under your name.

task.title: Create follow-up task
task.description: Creates a task assigned to the contractor company and linked to this event.

override.title: Override readiness
override.description: Overrides are recorded with your name, the time and the reason, and are visible in the history.
override.reasonPlaceholder: Why is the readiness being overridden?

reschedule.title: Reschedule event
reschedule.requiresReconfirmationHint: Earlier answers are kept in the history but no longer count.
reschedule.preparationHint: Leave empty to move the preparation deadline with the event.

outcome.title: Record outcome
outcome.description: Completed and partially completed outcomes need the actual start time. Any other outcome needs a note.

documents.noneAvailable: No project documents available to link.

calendar.sectionDescription: Multi-contractor events in this period with their readiness.
calendar.empty: No coordination events in this period.

portal.scheduleDescription: Site events you are invited to. Confirm your readiness before the preparation deadline.
portal.emptyUpcoming: No upcoming events for your company on this project.
portal.respondDescription: Choose your answer. Not ready, blocked and ready with conditions need a short explanation.

statusHints.ready: Everything is prepared on our side.
statusHints.ready_with_conditions: We can proceed if the conditions in the note are met.
statusHints.not_ready: We will not be ready in time.
statusHints.acknowledged: We received the invitation and are preparing.
statusHints.blocked: Something outside our control is blocking us.

portal.notePlaceholder: What is missing, what conditions apply, or what is blocking you?
portal.raiseIssue: Raise an issue for the site team
portal.cannotRespond: Answers are closed for this event.
portal.noRespondPermission: Your access lets you view this event but not answer it.
portal.attachEvidence: Add photos or documents to your last answer

validation.invalidDate: Enter a valid date and time.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
validation.preparationAfterStart: The preparation deadline must be before the start.
validation.notInProject: This item does not belong to the project.
validation.contractorNotOnProject: This contractor has no agreement on the project.
validation.documentNotInProject: This document is not linked to the project.
validation.unknownAcknowledgement: One of the acknowledgements no longer exists. Reload the page.

errors.eventClosed: This event is closed and can no longer be changed.
errors.eventNotOpen: This event is not open for readiness answers.
errors.cannotReschedule: This event can no longer be rescheduled.
errors.outcomeNotAllowed: This outcome is not possible for the event's current status.
errors.noOverride: There is no active readiness override to clear.
